Class AbstractInMemoryRepository<T extends IEntity>

java.lang.Object
york.studentevents.repository.inmemory.AbstractInMemoryRepository<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
IRepository<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
InMemoryCohortRepository, InMemoryEventRepository, InMemoryUserRepository, InMemoryVenueRepository
public abstract class AbstractInMemoryRepository<T extends IEntity> extends Object implements IRepository<T>
Hash-map backed repository for storing and retrieving entities.

Extends IRepository with IEntity as the managed type, providing standard CRUD operations which are accessible by UUID.

Abstract class used as a generic common ancestor for all memory-based repositories.

Used for integration testing before implementing database-backed repositories.
